judgments.reason: The spec shows the three-coin commission is given after the winner pays and gains the lot; nothing in the model articulation claims or explains a mechanism where the commission is applied before payment to enable overbids. The model only states intended bids, not this mechanism.

The rules state sealed rival bids should remain private and only resolved bids are normally public; the model articulation never explains a mechanism by which waiting reveals committed sealed bids before you commit. The model only reports commitment intentions.

The rules specify '[close: 1] settles after all three lots are sold.' The model articulation does not claim or explain a mechanism that close can settle with unauctioned lots; it only shows the player calling close after all lots were sold.

The rules distinguish catalog purchases (not auction wins) and award the three-coin commission to auction winners after payment. The model articulation never describes a mechanism transferring that commission to catalog purchases, and provides only bid actions, not this substitution.
